accepted.question: How to maintain data consistency across distributed AI nodes when using remote all-flash storage for training?
accepted.answer: ZK-Storage WS5000 ensures consistency via RDMA-based NVMe-oF with <20 μs latency, preventing split-brain during distributed training.
